cues.en: On March 3,
cues.zh: 3月3日，

cues.en: Doomworld user Vedge posted
cues.zh: Doomworld用户Vedge发帖

cues.en: on the forums he had finished a tribute map that he had made for Doom two called
cues.zh: 在论坛上说，他完成了一张为Doom制作的致敬地图，名叫

cues.en: my house
cues.zh: my house

cues.en: dot wad.
cues.zh: 点wad。

cues.en: Last August, I lost a good childhood friend of mine and took it pretty hard. When I was visiting my hometown for his funeral, I connected with his parents who shared with me some of his old belongings.
cues.zh: 去年八月，我失去了一位从小一起长大的好朋友，真的很难接受。我回老家参加他的葬礼时，和他的父母聊了聊，他们给了我一些他的旧物。

cues.en: Among them was a copy of an old map of his,
cues.zh: 其中有他一张旧地图的副本，

cues.en: backed up on a 3.5 inch floppy from high school. Thomas and I were into amateur doom mapping in the early two thousands, but I had never seen this map of his prior to uncovering it on one of the floppy disks. As a way of paying tribute to him and all the great memories we have together,
cues.zh: 备份在高中时的一张3.5英寸软盘里。Thomas和我在两千年初都热衷于业余Doom地图制作，但在这张软盘里翻到之前，我从没见过他这张地图。为了向他致敬，也纪念我们一起拥有的美好回忆，

cues.en: I took the plunge and installed Doom Builder in order to polish up his map and add a few modern amenities
cues.zh: 我下定决心安装了Doom Builder，把他这张地图打磨了一下，还加了一些现代化的小功能

cues.en: just for convenience sake.
cues.zh: 纯粹为了方便。

cues.en: Described with a ten minute run time, my house dot wad, wad being the file format for Doom maps and mods, was ready to download for anyone to play for themselves.
cues.zh: 据介绍流程大约十分钟，my house点wad——wad是Doom地图和模组的文件格式——已经可以下载，任何人都能自己玩。

cues.en: Making maps of your house was all the rage back in the day, but I feel like this is a pretty adorable and detailed tribute to my friend, and a great way to share something of him with the community we loved.
cues.zh: 当年给自己的房子做地图可太流行了，但我觉得这是对我朋友一个非常可爱又用心的致敬，也是把他的一部分分享给我们共同热爱的社区的好方式。

cues.en: Miss you, Tom.
cues.zh: 想你了，Tom。

cues.en: If you're at all into Doom and its extensive modding scene,
cues.zh: 如果你对Doom及其庞大的模组圈有一点兴趣，

cues.en: then I highly recommend playing this map for yourself
cues.zh: 那我强烈推荐你亲自玩玩这张地图，

cues.en: completely blind.
cues.zh: 完全不要预先了解。

cues.en: I'll put a link to the Doom World post in the description.
cues.zh: 我会把 Doom World 帖子的链接放在简介里。

cues.en: It requires g z Doom, an enhanced open source port of Doom to run. Simply click on the link, ignore everything else in the Google Drive, but the files folder, and download my house dot p k three.
cues.zh: 它需要 GZDoom——Doom 的增强开源移植版——才能运行。只需点链接，忽略 Google Drive 里除 files 文件夹之外的所有内容，下载 myhouse.pk3。

cues.en: Dot p k three,
cues.zh: .pk3，

cues.en: not
cues.zh: 不是

cues.en: dot wad.
cues.zh: .wad。

cues.en: See, if you hit that download link in the first week of this post appearing,
cues.zh: 你看，如果你在这个帖子发布后的第一周点那个下载链接，

cues.en: you would immediately get the p k three file instead of the wad that was stated in the title of the post. This whole drive of files also appeared later.
cues.zh: 你拿到的会直接是 pk3 文件，而不是帖子标题里说的 wad。整个 Drive 里这堆文件也是后来才出现的。

cues.en: P k three is another format used by Doom modders that functions like a wad, but it's essentially a zip folder,
cues.zh: pk3 是 Doom mod 作者使用的另一种格式，功能类似 wad，但本质上是一个 zip 文件夹，

cues.en: offering the benefits of a more organized file structure and also better compression.
cues.zh: 好处是文件结构更有条理，压缩率也更好。

cues.en: Curious then that this p k three file is 66
cues.zh: 那么奇怪的是，这个 pk3 文件有 66

cues.en: megabytes.
cues.zh: MB。

cues.en: For reference,
cues.zh: 对比一下，

cues.en: this is larger than Doom one and two's original file size combined
cues.zh: 这比 Doom 1 和 Doom 2 原始文件大小加起来还大

cues.en: four times over.
cues.zh: 而且是四倍。

cues.en: This was all the knowledge I had as I downloaded the file and fired it up for myself.
cues.zh: 这就是我下载文件并自己启动它时所掌握的全部信息。

cues.en: I'll be taking you through this map through several numbered expeditions.
cues.zh: 我会分几次编号探险，带大家过这张地图。

cues.en: Each one chronicling what I saw
cues.zh: 每次记录我所看到的东西

cues.en: as I attempted to journey through this
cues.zh: 当我试图穿越这张

cues.en: innocent map.
cues.zh: 人畜无害的地图时。

cues.en: That's cute. So I started this journey picking ultra violence difficulty because frankly,
cues.zh: 真可爱。我选择 Ultra-Violence 难度开始这趟旅程，因为说实话，

cues.en: I have an ego. The first thing I notice is a discomfortingly
cues.zh: 我有点自负。我注意到的第一件事，是让人不舒服地

cues.en: long load time.
cues.zh: 漫长的加载时间。

cues.en: That's not normal.
cues.zh: 这不太正常。

cues.en: But we're here. Classic Doom two opening song running from evil playing in the background. National anthem of Doom Wads everywhere.
cues.zh: 但我们进来了。经典 Doom 2 开场曲《Running from Evil》在背景里播放。到处都是 Doom WAD 的国歌。

cues.en: The house is rendered adorably.
cues.zh: 这栋房子渲染得很可爱。

cues.en: Big wooden walls and windows dotted around,
cues.zh: 大块木墙，窗户散布四周，

cues.en: featuring a spacious yard, a front porch area,
cues.zh: 还带一个宽敞的院子、一片前廊区域，

cues.en: and a large garage which leads into the house itself.
cues.zh: 以及一个通向屋内的大车库。

cues.en: The house is populated by demons,
cues.zh: 房子里住满了恶魔，

cues.en: but this is Doom. We can handle that. The main hallway leads to a living room with a TV and a tiny PlayStation one bringing the Doom Cute. Doom Cute being a community term for real life objects in spaces recreated in the Doom engine. You'll see more in the attached kitchen with all its amenities,
cues.zh: 但这是 Doom，我们能应付。主走廊通向客厅，里面有电视和一台小小的 PlayStation 1，带来 Doom Cute 的感觉。Doom Cute 是社区术语，指在 Doom 引擎重建的空间里的现实生活物品。相连的厨房设施齐全，你会看到更多这类细节，

cues.en: and to the side are various rooms. Two bedrooms, one containing an extra storage closet, and another with an en suite bathroom
cues.zh: 旁边是各种房间。两间卧室，一间多带一个储物壁橱，另一间带独立卫浴

cues.en: where you'll find the yellow key card.
cues.zh: 你会在那里找到黄色钥匙卡。

cues.en: Talk about a monster closet.
cues.zh: 这得叫怪物壁橱了。

cues.en: Also upstairs is a regular bathroom and a washing or utility room complete with a red key door.
cues.zh: 楼上还有一间普通浴室和一间洗衣/杂物间，配有一扇红钥匙门。

cues.en: Better find the key then. Moving downstairs takes us to more demons inside the games room.
cues.zh: 那就最好先找到钥匙。下楼后，游戏室里还有更多恶魔。

cues.en: But to interrupt this tour for a second, you may have noticed we did something here. This room is underneath the room upstairs.
cues.zh: 不过先打断一下这次参观，你可能注意到我们在这里做了点东西。这个房间就在楼上房间的正下方。

cues.en: If you don't know what I mean, that might sound like nothing, but that's an impossible thing in Doom. Doom's engine takes two dimensional map data and makes a three d space around it.
cues.zh: 如果你不明白我的意思，这听起来可能没什么，但在 Doom 里这是不可能的事。Doom 引擎会读取二维地图数据，并在其周围生成三维空间。

cues.en: I'm more or less simplifying here, but that means you can't have a room on top of another room in the engine. A separate story whether upstairs or downstairs
cues.zh: 我在这里多少做了简化，但这意味着引擎里不能出现一个房间叠在另一个房间上面。无论是楼上还是楼下，独立楼层

cues.en: is always in a separate space to the original floor, splintering off to another part of the building. Now, did say this was GZ Doom, but GZ Doom alone does not remove this limitation.
cues.zh: 总是与原楼层处于不同空间，分叉到建筑的另一个部分。我前面说过这是 GZ Doom，但光靠 GZ Doom 并不能消除这个限制。

cues.en: It updates the technology to benefit from newer hardware and provides enhancements suited for more modern gaming sensibilities,
cues.zh: 它更新了技术，以受益于更新的硬件，并提供了适合更现代游戏感觉的增强功能，

cues.en: but it more or less still has to obey
cues.zh: 但它或多或少仍然必须遵守

cues.en: the laws of Doom's reality.
cues.zh: 《毁灭战士》现实世界的法则。

cues.en: GZ Doom does open the possibility to some tricks to make this feat appear possible,
cues.zh: GZ Doom确实为一些技巧打开了可能性，使这一壮举看似可行，

cues.en: one's not uncommon in Doom modding and games similar to Doom, but we should probably move on already.
cues.zh: 这在《毁灭战士》模组制作和类似游戏中并不罕见，但我们可能该继续了。

cues.en: It seems strange to talk about such a detail at such length, but if you're familiar with doom, it's just something you might notice that'll make you pause for a moment. The innocuous map recreating a house suddenly shows
cues.zh: 花这么长时间讨论这样一个细节似乎很奇怪，但如果你熟悉《毁灭战士》，这恰恰是你可能会注意到并让你停顿片刻的东西。那张看似无害的重现房屋的地图突然展现出

cues.en: serious skill with its tools, yet it does it so casually as you may not even notice.
cues.zh: 运用工具的严肃技巧，却又做得如此随意，以至于你可能根本注意不到。

cues.en: Carrying on downstairs, we have more demons holding the fort in a closet, a boiler room, which leads to the garage, an office with some attached storage, another bedroom, complete with another closet, and lastly,
cues.zh: 继续往楼下走，我们有更多恶魔守在壁橱里、一间锅炉房，通向车库、一间带附属储藏室的办公室、另一间卧室（还带另一个壁橱），最后是

cues.en: another bathroom, locked with a yellow door for which we already have the key. I like the detail of putting the guy inside inside the shower. You get the red key card here and even some health in a cupboard if you need it. Equipment is actually pretty scarce on this map and playing on ultra violence offers some challenge. Hence, why you can see me saving ammo by punching pinkies.
cues.zh: 另一间浴室，用黄色门锁着，而我们已经有了钥匙。我喜欢把那个人放在淋浴间里的细节。你在这里拿到红色钥匙卡，如果需要的话，橱柜里甚至还有一些生命值。这张地图上的装备其实相当稀缺，在超暴力难度下游玩会带来一些挑战。因此，你能看到我用手拳打小恶魔来节省弹药。

cues.en: You might rush upstairs to the red door now or you might look outside and notice something.
cues.zh: 你现在可能冲上楼去开红门，或者你可能看向外面并注意到一些东西。

cues.en: There's a soul sphere,
cues.zh: 这里有一个灵魂球体，

cues.en: instant 100 health boost just sitting on that thing out there. I didn't see that earlier.
cues.zh: 那东西上面有个灵魂球，能瞬间提升100点生命值。我之前没看到。

cues.en: Did it spawn in while I was in here? You go back upstairs, grab the blue key card from the utility room door, which seemingly should be for the front gate, which leads to the level exit.
cues.zh: 是我在这里面的时候刷出来的吗？你回到楼上，从杂物间门上拿蓝色钥匙卡，那扇门似乎应该是通往前门的，而前门通往关卡出口。

cues.en: But while I could leave, I should probably grab that soul sphere first.
cues.zh: 但虽然我可以离开，我可能还是应该先拿到那个灵魂球。

cues.en: It should be right over here.
cues.zh: 它应该就在这边。

cues.en: It was definitely on top of this bin or vent thing here when I looked from that window over there.
cues.zh: 我从那边窗户看过去的时候，它分明就在这个垃圾桶或者通风口之类的东西上面。

cues.en: Wait.
cues.zh: 等等。

cues.en: Why can I see monsters inside?
cues.zh: 为什么我能看到里面有怪物？

cues.en: All around inside.
cues.zh: 里面到处都是。

cues.en: What's going on?
cues.zh: 怎么回事？

cues.en: Wait. That's not right.
cues.zh: 等等。这不对劲。

cues.en: The music just reset.
cues.zh: 音乐刚刚重置了。

cues.en: That wasn't me, that was the game. The level seems the same, now repopulated,
cues.zh: 那不是我干的，是游戏。关卡看起来还是一样的，现在重新刷满了怪物，

cues.en: but
cues.zh: 但是

cues.en: is it really?
cues.zh: 真的吗？

cues.en: I don't think that it is.
cues.zh: 我觉得不是。

cues.en: The keys I'm picking up are now skull keys, and now there are chain gunners in the level.
cues.zh: 我现在捡到的钥匙变成了骷髅钥匙，而且关卡里现在有链枪手了。

cues.en: There weren't any here before.
cues.zh: 之前这里根本没有这些。

cues.en: Does net me their gun though, so that's nice.
cues.zh: 不过这倒是让我拿到了他们的枪，所以还不错。

cues.en: I progressed through the level noticing differences such as seemingly functional mirrors and different item placements.
cues.zh: 我一路推进关卡，注意到了一些不同之处，比如看起来能用的镜子和不同的物品摆放位置。

cues.en: You might think to just leave already,
cues.zh: 你可能会想干脆直接离开，

cues.en: finish the level, but no.
cues.zh: 通关算了，但不行。

cues.en: You now need the blue skull key to exit.
cues.zh: 你现在需要蓝色骷髅钥匙才能出去。

cues.en: But then the cupboard to get the blue key is now a stairway to an attic.
cues.zh: 但那个放蓝色钥匙的橱柜现在变成了通往阁楼的楼梯。

cues.en: I didn't even know there was an attic to this house, But that's fine. With the blue key acquired, there's nothing else to stop me from exiting...
cues.zh: 我甚至都不知道这栋房子有阁楼，但没关系。拿到蓝色钥匙后，就没有什么能阻止我离开了……

cues.en: The doors are gone.
cues.zh: 门不见了。

cues.en: I'm not locked inside.
cues.zh: 我不是被锁在里面。

cues.en: I am
cues.zh: 我是

cues.en: trapped inside.
cues.zh: 被困在里面了。

cues.en: This closet too has appeared,
cues.zh: 这个壁橱也冒出来了，

cues.en: I think. It seemingly goes nowhere.
cues.zh: 我觉得。它似乎哪儿也通不去。

cues.en: I can't help but notice also the classic Doom two running from evil song.
cues.zh: 我还忍不住注意到，背景放着经典《Doom 2》的 Running from Evil。

cues.en: Does it sound
cues.zh: 听起来是不是

cues.en: wrong somehow?
cues.zh: 有点不对劲？

cues.en: Okay. Maybe if I look around, there's some other way outside?
cues.zh: 好吧。也许我四处转转，能找到其他出去的路？

cues.en: What?
cues.zh: 什么鬼？

cues.en: This can't exist.
cues.zh: 这不可能存在。

cues.en: Not just in Doom's reality, but reality's reality.
cues.zh: 不仅在 Doom 的世界里不可能，在真正的现实中也不可能。

cues.en: The corridor takes me to some new room, never seen before, featuring a fireplace and strange different decor
cues.zh: 走廊把我带到了一个从未见过的全新房间，里面有个壁炉，装修风格也诡异不同，

cues.en: and a can of Pepsi that I pick up.
cues.zh: 我还捡起了一罐 Pepsi。

cues.en: I want pop,
cues.zh: 我是想要汽水，

cues.en: but no way out. So I leave. The doors still aren't there. I turn back and
cues.zh: 但还是没有出路。所以我离开了。门依然不在。我转过身，然后——

cues.en: This
cues.zh: 这个

cues.en: space,
cues.zh: 空间，

cues.en: like some negative version of the house.
cues.zh: 就像是这栋房子的负片版本。

cues.en: The only object of note is a milkshake.
cues.zh: 唯一引人注意的东西是一杯奶昔。

cues.en: Yeah. Still nothing to help me though. I come back to the house and the first door is now gone, but also when I go to the front door or where it used to be,
cues.zh: 行吧。但这依然帮不上忙。我回到房子里，第一扇门现在不见了，而当我走到前门——或者说前门原本在的位置时，

cues.en: I hear a noise now.
cues.zh: 我听见了一声响动。

cues.en: Was this always behind here?
cues.zh: 这后面一直都藏着东西吗？

cues.en: I push the bookcase aside and find an odd room hidden away back here. Are those cat litter trays?
cues.zh: 我推开书架，发现后面藏着一个奇怪的房间。那些是猫砂盆吗？

cues.en: Anyway,
cues.zh: 不管了，

cues.en: I guess I'll press the breaker.
cues.zh: 我想我得去扳一下电闸。

cues.en: Monsters.
cues.zh: 怪物。

cues.en: But not the monsters that we know
cues.zh: 但并不是我们熟知的那种怪物，

cues.en: flood the dark smoky house.
cues.zh: 涌入了这栋昏暗且烟雾弥漫的房子。

cues.en: All corners,
cues.zh: 各个角落，

cues.en: all but transformed and looking like nothing that you... What you've seen.
cues.zh: 几乎面目全非，看起来完全不像你……曾经见过的任何东西。

cues.en: Clearing downstairs of all terrors,
cues.zh: 清理掉楼下所有的恐怖之物后，

cues.en: you might try to go upstairs where all the people
cues.zh: 你可能会试着上楼，而在那里

cues.en: are screaming.
cues.zh: 所有人都在尖叫。

cues.en: The house is a wreck.
cues.zh: 整栋房子破败不堪。

cues.en: More creatures haunt the upstairs, but it's clear that this fire
cues.zh: 楼上有更多的怪物出没，但很显然这场大火

cues.en: has been and gone. Amidst fighting underneath an angry sky, small objects litter the upstairs that you collect.
cues.zh: 已经熄灭了。在阴霾的天空下激战时，楼上散落着一些可以收集的小物件。

cues.en: A diary of some kind,
cues.zh: 某种日记，

cues.en: a burned out picture frame,
cues.zh: 一个烧焦的相框，

cues.en: and an old teddy bear.
cues.zh: 还有一只旧泰迪熊。

cues.en: We're still not free though.
cues.zh: 但我们依然没能逃脱。

cues.en: We can't even go back to the attic.
cues.zh: 我们甚至回不去阁楼了。

cues.en: But how was there an attic anyway?
cues.zh: 但话说回来，这里怎么会有阁楼？

cues.en: How can we escape?
cues.zh: 我们要怎么逃出去？

cues.en: There are no doors.
cues.zh: 根本没有门。

cues.en: I try every wall hoping that they give way and fall down to let you out, press the map button
cues.zh: 我试遍了每一面墙，希望它们能塌陷倒下放人出去，按下了地图键，

cues.en: and realize there is no map.
cues.zh: 才发现根本没有地图。

cues.en: We are
cues.zh: 我们身处

cues.en: nowhere.
cues.zh: 虚无之中。

cues.en: We can also spy the map details in the corner.
cues.zh: 我们还能在角落瞥见地图详情。

cues.en: That's a lot of monsters
cues.zh: 怪物可真不少，

cues.en: and just
cues.zh: 而且只有

cues.en: one secret.
cues.zh: 一个秘密。

cues.en: None of this counts as a secret then. You might venture back downstairs.
cues.zh: 看来这些都不算秘密。你也许会冒险重新下楼。

cues.en: Things look different.
cues.zh: 景象变得不一样了。

cues.en: Everything is concrete now. In fact, outside looks grey,
cues.zh: 一切都变成了混凝土。事实上，外面看起来灰蒙蒙的，

cues.en: monochrome for some reason.
cues.zh: 不知为何变成了单色调。

cues.en: You go into the boiler room perhaps. Wasn't there a door here that led to the garage?

cues.zh: 我望向窗外看下方地面，发现地形很陌生。

cues.en: I had no idea where I was or where I was going. Suddenly the plane started to shake violently
cues.zh: 我不知道自己在哪里，也不知道要去哪里。突然飞机开始剧烈摇晃

cues.en: and I heard a loud noise coming from the engine. In the distance I could see a huge storm cloud coming towards me. I tried to communicate with the pilot but I couldn't hear him over the sound of the engine. The plane began to dive and suddenly I felt a huge jolt. I looked out the window again and saw that the plane was heading for some kind of structure. I closed my eyes and felt the plane crash. I felt the impact and heard the screams and cries from the people around me.
cues.zh: 我听到引擎传来巨响。远处我能看到一团巨大的风暴云朝我袭来。我试图和飞行员沟通，但引擎声太大听不见他。飞机开始俯冲，突然我感到一阵剧烈震动。我再次望向窗外，看到飞机正冲向某种建筑结构。我闭上眼睛，感觉到飞机坠毁了。我感受到撞击，听到周围人们的尖叫和哭喊。

cues.en: I then woke up, my heart pounding and my body drenched in sweat.
cues.zh: 我随后醒来，心脏狂跳，浑身大汗淋漓。

cues.en: Congratulations.
cues.zh: 恭喜。

cues.en: We've finally caught up.
cues.zh: 我们终于赶上了。

cues.zh: 房子现在和以前一模一样，说明我们终于成功了，

cues.en: except that flower painting
cues.zh: 只是那幅花卉画

cues.en: now isn't.
cues.zh: 现在不一样了。

cues.en: What an interesting picture.
cues.zh: 多么有趣的一幅画。

cues.en: And the doors are back, so you could leave,
cues.zh: 而且门又回来了，所以你可以离开，

cues.en: which at this point would be silly.
cues.zh: 不过现在走的话就太傻了。

cues.en: Why would we do that when we can take this rabbit hole as far as we can go?
cues.zh: 既然能把这个兔子洞钻到底，我们又何必离开呢？

cues.en: Before you ask, no. This doesn't open until you get all the items.
cues.zh: 在你问之前，先说答案：不。这东西要集齐所有道具才会打开。

cues.zh: 终于

cues.zh: 一个新地方。

cues.zh: 我想除了这条路，没别的地方可去了。

cues.zh: 这条漫长

cues.zh: 这辆撞毁的车似乎通往一个美式加油站。

cues.zh: 我对这个感觉很好。

cues.en: This music too
cues.zh: 这音乐也

cues.zh: 让我想起了我曾经经历过的一场大乱斗。

cues.en: Inside the saw you can find the final item,
cues.zh: 在电锯里面你可以找到最后一件道具，

cues.en: an Atari 2,600
cues.zh: 一个 Atari 2600

cues.en: controller.
cues.zh: 手柄。

cues.en: There's not much else here to see,
cues.zh: 这里也没什么别的好看的了，

cues.en: a bus stop and a lit up sign. So the only thing we can do now is follow this trail of blood to this last room.
cues.zh: 一个公交车站和一个亮着的牌子。所以我们现在能做的，就是沿着这条血迹走到最后一个房间。

cues.en: Oh.
cues.zh: 哦。

cues.zh: 哦，天哪。

cues.zh: 求求你别告诉我那家店又是那栋房子。你知道吗？没关系。因为现在我们有了道具，

cues.en: and now the mirror world painting has something to show us as well.
cues.zh: 现在镜中世界的画作也有东西要向我们展示了。

cues.zh: 非常有意思。

cues.en: So we leave and sure enough, the fence opens in the same if mirrored place
cues.zh: 于是我们离开，果不其然，栅栏在镜像对应的地方打开了，

cues.en: and in we go.
cues.zh: 然后我们走了进去。

cues.en: It's a long road back to the station, and you could miss it being the map is flipped around because the car isn't here anymore.
cues.zh: 回车站的路很长，由于地图翻转了而且车已经不在了，你可能会错过它。

cues.en: There's a tiny torch instead,
cues.zh: 取而代之的是一支微弱的手电筒，

cues.en: but it leads to the gas station all the same.
cues.zh: 但它同样通往加油站。

cues.zh: 也许并非完全一样。

cues.en: I try and poke around a bit and there is a rocket launcher in the storeroom.
cues.zh: 我试着四处查看，储藏室里居然有一个火箭发射器。

cues.en: Oh, very nice.
cues.zh: 哦，太棒了。

cues.en: Why am I being given a rocket launcher?
cues.zh: 为什么会给我一个火箭发射器？

cues.en: There's no way past the tape into the rest of the store or into the house bathroom.
cues.zh: 根本无法穿过警戒线去往商店的其他地方或屋里的洗手间。

cues.en: So we'll go where we need to. Sure enough, standing out by the sign, we can see the smoke above the trees
cues.zh: 所以我们去该去的地方。果不其然，站在路标旁，我们可以看到树林上方的烟雾，

cues.en: and hidden between all of them is a little camp area.
cues.zh: 在它们之间隐藏着一个小型营地。

cues.en: You can actually go here in the regular world, but there's nothing here. Meanwhile,
cues.zh: 你在现实世界里其实也能来这儿，但这里什么都没有。与此同时，

cues.zh: 我们发现树上有个雕刻？S 加 a。

cues.en: What the...
cues.zh: 什么鬼……

cues.en: Get out of here. No.
cues.zh: 滚开。不。

cues.en: What the hell?
cues.zh: 搞什么鬼？

cues.en: I can't
cues.zh: 我回不

cues.en: go back.
cues.zh: 去了。

cues.en: Wait.
cues.zh: 等等。

cues.en: What is that?
cues.zh: 那是什么？

cues.en: Congratulations
cues.zh: 恭喜

cues.en: on achieving ending two.
cues.zh: 达成结局二。

cues.en: No. Really, this is an ending. You might have some questions,
cues.zh: 不。真的，这就是个结局。你可能有些疑问，

cues.en: but fortunately,
cues.zh: 不过好在，

cues.en: there's another dream to tell you about.
cues.zh: 还有另一个梦要讲给你听。

cues.en: I can no longer tell what elements of this map are my friends, which are mine, and what the map has created. I am no longer afraid that the map is creating itself. It needs me as much as I need it, which reminds me of a dream I had the other night. I'm not sleeping much, but I recall this one with surprising clarity. I was standing on a beach staring out at the placid water, the ocean stretching out as far as the eye could see. Seagulls crawled overhead and the gentle caress of water raps the sand in front of me. I dipped my toes into the water.
cues.zh: 我再也分不清这张地图的哪些元素是我的朋友，哪些属于我，以及什么是地图自己生成的。我不再害怕地图会自行演化。它需要我，正如我需要它，这让我想起前天晚上的一个梦。我睡眠不多，但这个梦我却记得异常清晰。我站在海滩上凝视着平静的水面，大海一望无际。海鸥在头顶盘旋，温柔的海水拍打着我面前的沙滩。我把脚趾浸入水中。

cues.en: At least I tried. There was no water, no ocean. It was an illusion. I realized everything around me was fake. The trees, the birds, the sand, it was all a one act prey.
cues.zh: 至少我试过了。没有水，没有海洋。那只是幻觉。我意识到周围的一切都是假的。树木、鸟儿、沙滩，全都是一场骗局。

cues.en: And I was Willy Lohman,
cues.zh: 而我就是威利·洛曼，

cues.en: a damned fool who believed in something greater,
cues.zh: 一个相信更伟大事物的该死傻瓜，

cues.en: but there was no happiness to be found. I wanted the set only to find myself staring into oblivion.
cues.zh: 但那里没有幸福可寻。我追寻那场景，却发现自己凝视着虚无。

cues.en: It was the end of time itself.
cues.zh: 那是时间本身的终结。

cues.en: No joy, no misery, no sadness, only empty ness. Men of faith tell us the afterlife is for eternity. But is it possible to keep your sanity for eternity?
cues.zh: 没有欢乐，没有痛苦，没有悲伤，只有空虚。信仰者告诉我们来世是永恒的。但你能在永恒中保持理智吗？

cues.en: A day passes in the void. A month, a year, two, five, ten. Is this an eternity? Twenty years. A hundred years. A thousand years. I've sat in this room for a million years now entertaining the same thoughts, pondering the same questions, and ruminated on every mistake in my life,
cues.zh: 在虚空中一天过去。一个月，一年，两年，五年，十年。这是永恒吗？二十年。一百年。一千年。我已在这个房间里坐了一百万年，重复同样的想法，思考同样的问题，反复咀嚼我生命中的每一个错误，

cues.en: anguishing over them for centuries.
cues.zh: 为之痛苦了几个世纪。

cues.en: A billion years now. Double that. Now double it again. I'm still nowhere close to the end of eternity. I pray for death but it never comes. Just me and my thoughts and my mistakes and my insecurities and my regrets and my loneliness.
cues.zh: 现在十亿年了。翻倍。再翻倍。我仍远未接近永恒的尽头。我祈求死亡，但它从不降临。只有我、我的想法、我的错误、我的不安、我的悔恨和我的孤独。

cues.en: Somewhere in another dream, the version of myself, the winked back, is sitting on the real beach, happy and content,
cues.zh: 在另一个梦的某处，那个版本的我，那个眨眼回应的我，正坐在真实的海滩上，快乐而满足，

cues.en: knowing that life is finite,
cues.zh: 知道生命是有限的，

cues.en: there is no afterlife, and happiness is found in the small things around us that we can control.
cues.zh: 没有来世，幸福存在于我们周围那些我们能掌控的小事中。

cues.en: Happiness
cues.zh: 幸福

cues.en: has to be fought for.
cues.zh: 必须去争取。

cues.en: Time to fight for your happy ending.
cues.zh: 是时候为你幸福的结局而战了。

cues.en: Once you lower the entrance to the fake beach, it's time to get running. Escape from the shadowy archvile who is basically unkillable.
cues.zh: 一旦你降下假海滩的入口，就该开跑了。逃离那个基本杀不死的暗影大恶魔。

cues.en: You can stun them pretty easily,
cues.zh: 你可以很轻松地眩晕它们，

cues.en: but it's easier to just run and never stop.
cues.zh: 但更简单的办法就是一直跑，绝不停下。

cues.en: They will teleport and chase you even into the mirror house where they'll start resurrecting the dead monsters.
cues.zh: 它们会瞬移追你，甚至追进镜屋，然后开始复活死去的怪物。

cues.en: So we're going to have to flee to the regular world pronto,
cues.zh: 所以我们得赶紧逃回现实世界，

cues.en: which is now repopulated
cues.zh: 而那里现在也重新被占据了

cues.en: too and has arch vials as well. But fortunately,
cues.zh: 同样有暗影大恶魔。但幸运的是，

cues.en: ones that we can kill by carefully peeking in and out of sight of their attacks. I probably should have just b f g'd them, but I felt proud when I did it
cues.zh: 这些我们可以通过小心地探头躲闪它们的攻击来击杀。我大概应该直接用 BFG 轰掉它们，但做到的时候我还挺自豪的

cues.en: until I saw outside.
cues.zh: 直到我看到外面。

cues.en: It's worse when you open the door.
cues.zh: 打开门的时候更糟。

cues.en: Before we leave, go back up to the attic and look into the mirror. This shadowy arch vile has taken the spot where the Christmas bauble used to be.
cues.zh: 走之前，回到阁楼看看镜子里。这个暗影大恶魔占据了原本圣诞球所在的位置。

cues.zh: 多么

cues.en: Getting out of the house is tricky. I like to do a lap around the house to get them in fighting and thin their number a little. I also want to stock up slightly with these items, but not really fight them.
cues.zh: 离开房子很棘手。我喜欢绕着房子跑一圈，把它们引出来打一打，削减一下数量。我也想稍微囤一点这些道具，但并不真的跟它们打。

cues.en: Our battle isn't here. We need to hit the road again,
cues.zh: 我们的战斗不在这里。我们得再次上路，

cues.en: which by the way has one last dream to mention.
cues.zh: 顺便说，还有一个梦要提。

cues.en: I was driving along a road in the woods when all of a sudden my car veered off the road and crashed into a tree. I woke up to find myself in the driver's seat with an injured and bleeding leg. My head was spinning and I felt disoriented.
cues.zh: 我正沿着林间的一条路开车，突然车子偏离了道路，撞上了一棵树。我醒来发现自己坐在驾驶座上，腿受了伤还在流血。我头晕目眩，感觉迷失了方向。

cues.en: I dragged myself out of the car and hobbled my way through the woods in hopes of finding help. My leg was in agony and I felt like I was going to faint. Through the trees, I saw the lights from a lonely gas station. I was relieved to find it open but then I realized there was nobody there. I had no idea where everybody had gone. As I was standing there, I heard some strange noises coming from the woods around me. I was too scared to investigate so I just stood there feeling scared and alone. Suddenly, I heard a car in the distance and I limped towards it. Thank goodness.
cues.zh: 我挣扎着从车里出来，一瘸一拐地穿过树林，希望能找到人帮忙。我的腿疼得要命，感觉自己快要晕过去了。透过树林，我看到一座孤零零的加油站亮着灯。发现它开着让我松了口气，但随即我意识到那里一个人也没有。我不知道大家都去哪儿了。我站在那里的时候，听到周围的树林里传来一些奇怪的声音。我太害怕了，不敢去查看，只能站在那里，感到恐惧又孤独。突然，我听到远处有车的声音，就一瘸一拐地朝它走去。谢天谢地。

cues.en: It was a taxi driver who was able to take me to the hospital. I eventually woke up in a cold sweat, not sure if I was relieved or disappointed
cues.zh: 那是个出租车司机，他能把我送到医院。最后我在一身冷汗中醒来，不确定自己是松了口气还是感到失望

cues.en: that it was just a dream.
cues.zh: 原来那只是个梦。

cues.en: And with that, there's only one last fight left for us.
cues.zh: 就这样，我们只剩下最后一场战斗了。

cues.en: The gas station is surrounded by monsters from all sides despite a mastermind sitting atop the courtyard roof.
cues.zh: 加油站被四面八方的怪物包围着，尽管有个幕后黑手坐在庭院屋顶上。

cues.en: It's a tough fight,
cues.zh: 这是一场艰难的战斗，

cues.en: but happiness
cues.zh: 但幸福

cues.en: has to be fought for.
cues.zh: 是需要去争取的。

cues.en: Hold on a second guys.
cues.zh: 等一下各位。

cues.en: I just I just need a quick break.
cues.zh: 我只是，我只是需要稍微休息一下。

cues.en: Oh.
cues.zh: 哦。

cues.en: Very nice.
cues.zh: 非常不错。

cues.en: And here is the true ending.
cues.zh: 而这里就是真正的结局。

cues.en: The one secret finally discovered to tell you that this is the end.
cues.zh: 那个秘密终于被发现了，告诉你这就是终点。

cues.en: This beach is real. Actual peace is here for you. And if the dog in the maze survives, then they join you on this beach as well to cap everything off. The nightmare is finally over.
cues.zh: 这片海滩是真实的。真正的安宁就在这里等着你。而如果迷宫里的狗活了下来，它们也会在这片海滩上与你汇合，为一切画上句号。噩梦终于结束了。

cues.en: You've completed my house
cues.zh: 你通关了 MyHouse，

cues.en: and can relax knowing there's nothing else left to see.
cues.zh: 终于可以松口气，以为已经没有什么可看的了。

cues.en: Well,
cues.zh: 但，

cues.en: actually,
cues.zh: 实际上，

cues.en: what if you collected all the items,
cues.zh: 要是你收集了所有物品，

cues.en: unlocking the secret passage in Liard,
cues.zh: 解锁了 Liard 里的秘密通道，

cues.en: but then burn the house down anyway.
cues.zh: 却依然把房子付之一炬呢？

cues.en: What if you fought your way through the burned out house again? The brutalist maze went through the airport that has no plane, but you still fall back down into the now destroyed house.
cues.zh: 要是你再次杀穿那座烧毁的房子呢？穿越野兽派风格的迷宫，经过那座没有飞机的机场，却依然跌落回如今已成废墟的房子里。

cues.en: What if you did all of that,
cues.zh: 要是你做完了这一切，

cues.en: left the house,
cues.zh: 走出房子，

cues.en: and then opened the fence passage?
cues.zh: 然后打开了栅栏通道呢？

cues.en: This isn't an ending,
cues.zh: 这并不是一个结局，

cues.en: but it is a little secret for you.
cues.zh: 但却是一份留给你的小秘密。

cues.en: My phone couldn't read this QR code, but fortunately,
cues.zh: 我的手机扫不出这个二维码，但幸运的是，

cues.en: someone very kind and clever in the Doomworld forums transcribed the code into something readable, which takes you to a new hidden photo in that Google Drive.
cues.zh: Doomworld 论坛里有位热心又聪明的网友把这段代码转录成了可读内容，它会带你看到那个 Google Drive 里一张新的隐藏照片。

cues.en: An obituary
cues.zh: 一份讣告，

cues.en: for Steve Nelson.
cues.zh: 属于 Steve Nelson。

cues.en: Steve died
cues.zh: Steve 的逝世时间

cues.en: on the exact same day that Tom died,
cues.zh: 和 Tom 完全是同一天，

cues.en: What does this mean? Does it mean that Steven's spirit made this doom map as his last connection to the outside world?
cues.zh: 这意味着什么？难道是 Steven 的在天之灵制作了这张 Doom 地图，作为他与现实世界的最后连结吗？

cues.en: Is this meant to be some metatextual
cues.zh: 这难道是一种元文本层面上

cues.en: statement on the death of the author?
cues.zh: 对“作者之死”的隐喻表达吗？

cues.en: I don't have a sole definitive
cues.zh: 我没有唯一确切的

cues.en: answer,
cues.zh: 答案，

cues.en: and I'm not sure one really exists for me. But this does open up some interesting rabbit holes.
cues.zh: 我甚至不确定对我而言是否存在这样的答案。但这确实引出了不少耐人寻味的探索方向。

cues.en: Was it actually Steve who wrote the journal?
cues.zh: 这篇日志实际上是 Steve 写的吗？

cues.en: Rereading the journal after discovering this, it suddenly struck me how rarely names are used.
cues.zh: 发现这一点后再重读日志，我猛然意识到里面极少提及具体姓名。

cues.en: Instead using my childhood friend or just my friend when referring to who I presumed to be Tom. It's only in February
cues.zh: 在指代我原本以为是 Tom 的那个人时，通篇只用“我发小”或“我朋友”。直到2023年

cues.en: where Thomas is finally named and positively identified as the person who started the map on the floppy disk, which I guess the forum post also confirmed. Steve isn't named anywhere in here, which might support the idea that he's the one writing it. At first though, I wondered if the vagueness of the journal meant there was a third person who wrote it. cues.zh: 从最简单的射击地图到人们从未见过的奇异新体验。在这个词的最真切意义上，这张地图表明 Doom

cues.en: really is
cues.zh: 确实是

cues.en: eternal.
cues.zh: 永恒的。

cues.en: There's one more detail from the journal I'd like to close on. It's a flimsy observation,
cues.zh: 日记里还有一个细节我想作为结尾。这是一个微不足道的观察，

cues.en: but bear with me anyway. In the text are three numbers highlighted in red. In order, they are two,
cues.zh: 但还是请听我讲完。文本中有三个用红色高亮显示的数字。按顺序，它们是二、

cues.en: three,
cues.zh: 三、

cues.en: one.
cues.zh: 一。

cues.en: I don't see any connections between the journal entries they are attached to, and the number means nothing in the context of the map. So I googled Doom two three one and found a music track from OC Remix.
cues.zh: 我看不出它们所附属的日记条目之间有什么联系，而且在这个地图的语境下，这个数字毫无意义。所以我谷歌搜索了“Doom two three one”，并找到了 OC Remix 上的一个音乐曲目。

cues.en: OC Remix numbers its tracks sequentially.
cues.zh: OC Remix 的曲目是按顺序编号的。

cues.en: So the fact it's a Doom song specifically
cues.zh: 所以它恰好是一首 Doom 的歌曲，

cues.en: at number two three one feels like a pretty extraordinary coincidence.
cues.zh: 编号又是二三一，感觉真是一个相当不可思议的巧合。

cues.en: The song itself is a remix of Sign of Evil from Doom one and I can't help but think when listening to it that it may have been an inspiration for the creation
cues.zh: 这首歌本身是 Doom 1 中《Sign of Evil》的重混版，听着它时我禁不住想，它可能就是创作

cues.en: of the whole map.
cues.zh: 整张地图的灵感来源。

cues.en: Even if I'm wrong and it wasn't that big an inspiration,
cues.zh: 就算我猜错了，它没起到那么大的灵感作用，

cues.en: it's a nice song anyway.
cues.zh: 它也是首好歌。

cues.en: Really makes me feel
cues.zh: 真的让我感到

cues.en: happy.
cues.zh: 快乐。

cues.en: Thank you for watching this long delayed
cues.zh: 谢谢观看这期

cues.en: video.
cues.zh: 跳票已久的视频。

cues.en: I've been in not the best shape while working on this. And to be honest, playing through this map over and over again
cues.zh: 在制作这个视频期间，我的状态不太好。老实说，一遍又一遍地玩这张地图

cues.en: wasn't helping matters.
cues.zh: 对我的状况并没有什么帮助。

cues.en: Then I got sick on top of that, again, I know, which delayed things further.
cues.zh: 然后我又生病了，真是雪上加霜，我知道，这让进度更加拖延了。

cues.en: Production was pretty difficult anyway. I made some of the ambiance for sections of this video by stretching some of Doom's songs and layering different versions together. It was a lot, but I had fun and I'm glad it's now here for everyone.
cues.zh: 制作过程本来就挺困难的。我为这个视频的某些段落制作了一些氛围音效，方法是将一些 Doom 的歌曲拉伸，并把不同版本叠加在一起。工作量很大，但我乐在其中，很高兴现在能呈现给大家。

cues.en: And an extra special thank you to all my patrons.
cues.zh: 特别感谢我所有的赞助人。

cues.en: Your support and your patience
cues.zh: 你们的支持和耐心

cues.en: humbles me. So now, let's get into questions.
cues.zh: 让我深感谦卑。那么现在，让我们进入提问环节。

cues.en: What were your thoughts on house of leaves? In particular, did you read it in any specific manner?
cues.zh: 你对《House of Leaves》有什么看法？特别是，你有没有以某种特定的方式阅读它？

cues.en: I
cues.zh: 我

cues.en: adore house of leaves.
cues.zh: 非常喜欢《House of Leaves》。

cues.en: It's not often I think about rereading a book that I've just finished reading.
cues.zh: 我很少会想重读一本刚读完的书。

cues.en: I personally read the entire main story first and only read the appendices once I finished the Novitzian record with the exception of the Pelican poems.
cues.zh: 我个人是先读完了整个主线故事，直到读完 Navidson 记录才去读附录，Pelican 的诗除外。

cues.en: For some reason, I couldn't even tell you. I think this is why I'm curious to go back as I took the words written at their face value without any other context. But now I have read the appendices,
cues.zh: 不知为何，我也说不上来。我想这就是为什么我很好奇想回去重读——因为我当时只是按字面意思理解那些文字，没有任何其他背景。但现在我已经读过了附录，

cues.en: I want to see how I now view the narrative as presented.
cues.zh: 我想看看自己现在会如何看待所呈现的叙事。

cues.en: Let me take this moment to give a heartfelt recommendation
cues.zh: 让我借此机会真心推荐

cues.en: to read House of Leaves for anyone who's still watching. Despite its reputation,
cues.zh: 还在观看的各位去读一读《House of Leaves》。尽管它名声在外，

cues.en: it's quite an approachable book and you can get in the swing of its layout and style very naturally.
cues.zh: 它其实是一本相当平易近人的书，你会很自然地适应它的排版和风格。

cues.en: Don't be put off by the look of it or me talking about appendixes.
cues.zh: 别被它的外观或者我提到附录给吓退了。

cues.en: It may have taken me two attempts to read through it, but that's only because I first tried reading it while traveling.
cues.zh: 我可能读了两遍才看完，那纯粹是因为我第一次是在旅行途中看的。

cues.en: And that's a bad idea for a book you need to flip and turn and read back and forth. Reading in the comfort of your own home is best.
cues.zh: 对于一本需要翻来翻去、前后对照着读的书来说，这可不是个好主意。还是在自己家里舒舒服服地读最好。
